s1.syndrome_frame: inflammatory arthritis and skin lesions with systemic symptoms
key_facts: man in his 50s
dermal papules on trunk and extremities
preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs
no lymphadenopathy
relief of symptoms with daily oral prednisone
flare of symptoms with taper below 10 mg
previous treatments included hydroxychloroquine and adalimumab without improvement
mild restrictive disease on pulmonary function tests
nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate on skin biopsy
atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes on skin biopsy
low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining
clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample

shortlist.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: presence of atypical lymphocytes, clonal rearrangements, and abnormal immunostaining results

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: dermal papules and inflammatory arthritis, although some features are atypical

shortlist.label: Amyopathic dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: skin lesions without muscle involvement, but some systemic symptoms are present

shortlist.label: Erythema elevatum diutinum
shortlist.why_kept: dermal papules on extensor surfaces, but lack of other characteristic features

shortlist.label: Granuloma annulare
shortlist.why_kept: dermal papules, but histopathology does not fully support this diagnosis

joint.why: inflammatory arthritis is not specific to any candidate
fatigue is a common symptom of dermatomyositis
dyspnea on exertion is not specific to these dermatological conditions
